fields.Name: C2 -> S4.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.19 (phase 2, dataset C2, criterion S4.1): on C2 (2% fraud) log loss, not accuracy, ranks and gates: a near-constant candidate listed first ranks above 0 candidates whose inner log-loss interval lies below its own, the finalist's holdout log loss beats the constant predictor's, and the gate does not end no-signal, 1 of 1. It fails when candidate selection ranks the inner folds by accuracy instead of log loss (the near-constant candidate becomes the finalist).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: On C2 the near-constant candidate ranks above no candidate with a better inner log loss; the finalist beats the constant predictor on holdout log loss (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
